name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to validate its feedback loop against real-world merges without risking open PRs. The trade-off is delayed feedback on open PRs, but merged PRs are safer to test against since they’re already approved.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs only catches errors *after* they’re already in product—it’s a post-mortem, not prevention. A better test is running PR-Agent in shadow mode on *open* PRs first; that catches issues before they ship, not after. Settle it by comparing error rates in production vs. open PRs after a week of each approach.
